current.text: He is a projected starter for Golden State.
He is unlikely to play center because he is old and small.
His Yahoo ADP of 107 is too high. The expert sees him outside the top 120 in categories because of his age and because he fades when Curry sits.
He is good value in deep leagues around picks 160 to 180, but not worth taking in shallow leagues or in round 13 of a 12-team league.
One expert has him in tier nine at center and is souring on him more every day.
Golden State is reportedly treating this season as a gap year and is worried about lottery odds.
The team may rest veterans, and Warriors players are expected to fade as the season goes on.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs this season, tied for second most.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He is better in category leagues than in points leagues.
His value comes from rebounds and assists. His steals and blocks are no longer a strength.
His assists are far above the norm for a forward or center.
